evidence.r1: Top planner and route-choice menu are controls; lower title and route summary are solid in both schemes.
evidence.r2: Open route menu replaces its trigger and uses a flat selected-row fill in both schemes.
evidence.r3: Three top surfaces serve route choice, weather and permits in both schemes.
evidence.r4: Top capsules and expanded route menu share the same frosted appearance in both schemes.
evidence.r5: No clear variant is visible; top planner is frosted over the lake in light and dark.
evidence.r6: Top controls have neutral backgrounds and labels, with no competing tints in either scheme.
evidence.r7: Light route menu visibly picks up forest and lake colours rather than a uniform replacement fill.
evidence.r8: Top controls are capsules and the route menu is a fixed-radius rectangle in both schemes.
evidence.r9: Light menu selected row has a smaller rounded end inset evenly from the outer menu.
evidence.r10: Top permit and route controls have capsule outlines in both schemes.
evidence.r11: Top bar separates route, weather and permits into exactly three groups in both schemes.
evidence.r12: Top route pictogram and chevron belong to one text control, not separate icon buttons, in both schemes.
evidence.r13: Route selector and its menu each have one outer material surface in both schemes.
evidence.r14: Top capsules have broad deliberate separation and consistent material in both schemes.
evidence.r15: No scroll-edge treatment is visible at the top planner in either supplied full capture.
evidence.r16: Top capsules sit over detailed forest; route menu spans forest and lake in both schemes.
evidence.r17: Lake and forest imagery remains directly beneath the top planner in both schemes.
evidence.r18: Dark top weather text is pale on mid-grey glass; the specified numeric contrast is not established by the captures.
evidence.r19: Light reduced capture preserves planner labels, but increased contrast and reduced motion are not shown.
evidence.r20: Lake photograph reaches both window edges beneath the floating planner in both schemes.
evidence.r21: Top controls overlay the photograph; no safe-area clearing or extension behaviour is demonstrated in either scheme.
evidence.r22: Top planner floats directly over the photograph without an extra backing strip in both schemes.
evidence.r23: Light and dark route-menu endpoints do not show morphing or pointer press feedback.
evidence.r24: Top controls and menu labels are neutral; green and purple occur in lower content in both schemes.
evidence.r25: Top labels are dark over pale material in light and pale over grey material in dark, not lake-coloured.
